overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board could use Purpose 6 for ongoing renegotiation of contingencies under an executed purchase agreement, so the executive session was proper.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly relied on Purpose 6 to discuss a South Sandwich Village Center project after the purchase and sales agreement had already been executed.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board had an ongoing negotiation position to protect during its October 22, 2015 meeting, we find that the Board properly entered executive session under Purpose 6 after the Chair's declared that holding the discussion in open session would have a detrimental effect on the Board's negotiating position.
